headline: Joey Lands the Two-for-One Knockout
verdict: Joey is the clear current winner, taking the A-rated side of a deal Evan receives a C- for.
summary: This is a decisive value win for Joey on the supplied numbers. He turns one Dalvin Cook asset valued at 43.2 into A.J. Brown at 87.9 and Najee Harris at 66.5, while posting a 93.6 overall score against Evan’s 71.9. Joey’s 7-7 roster gets a major lineup-impact boost from a high-value wide receiver and a running back whose recent average, 16.7, exceeds his 12.4 season average. Evan does improve positional fit with a three-RB roster, but the exchange gives away the highest-ranked player in the deal and another productive piece for a player with a 617 search rank and 6.6 recent average. That is a steep hill, even for a former champion.
